responsibility: This file lowers resolved Fortran intrinsic calls and intrinsic subroutines to GCC trees, choosing between GCC builtins, libm entry points, and libgfortran helper routines according to intrinsic identity and operand kind. It maintains the intrinsic-to-builtin/library mapping tables, constructs kind-specific declarations, and emits code for intrinsic semantics that need custom lowering such as MOVE_ALLOC, atomic intrinsics, C interoperability helpers, coarray collectives/communication, SYSTEM_CLOCK, RANDOM_INIT, and related runtime interactions.
